subject: Biotechnology
title: Cytokine Therapies
description: Learn Cytokine Therapies in one minute.

hook.text: Cytokines are the immune system's text messages — amplifying, calming, or redirecting immune responses.

buildup.text: IL-2 stimulates T cell growth — high-dose IL-2 was one of the first immunotherapies for metastatic melanoma.

discovery.text: TNF blockers like infliximab calm overactive immunity — transforming treatment for rheumatoid arthritis and Crohn's.

twist.text: Cytokine storms kill — COVID deaths were partly caused by runaway IL-6 and TNF. Too much immune signaling is fatal.

climax.text: Engineered cytokines with extended half-lives and reduced toxicity are entering trials — precision immune tuning.

punchline.text: Boost or silence the immune signal — cytokines are the volume knob.

quiz.question: What is a cytokine storm?
options: A rapid increase in antibody production during vaccination
A dangerous overproduction of immune signaling molecules that can damage organs
The normal immune response to bacterial infections
